POC scope: embed CodeBind assistant inside VSCode + JetBrains; primary goal is reproducible code completion across releases.
- Wants model/version pinning + rollout controls: canaries -> gated rollout -> automatic rollback on eval regression.
- Latency target: median <30ms for completions, p99 <120ms. Throughput: ~150 concurrent active devs per shard (burst to 1k).
- Cost sensitivity: mid (willing to pay for dedicated if SLOs met). Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching vs latency tradeoffs.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs per session, KMS for customer keys, and optional on-prem bundle for regulated customers.
- Quote from Eng lead: "We cannot have completion behavior shift unpredictably after editor updates — reproducibility for customer-facing copilots is a hard requirement."
- POC notes: using a pinned model artifact (v1.3.2-quant) initially; testing rollback to v1.2.x when a regression was detected. Need eval-gate definition: currently using fixed test prompts + user-acceptance metric (manual).
- Ask: can Redwood expose per-plugin model pin + canary config via API and provide automated eval-gate integration (run predefined prompt set at rollout time)? Also need deterministic seeds and deterministic decoding options documented.
- Sales notes: potential ARR 50k-150k if dedicated + support for on-prem packaging. Customer open to annual commit after successful on-prem pilot.
- Internal next: provide detailed plan for eval gates (suggested: automated eval run on rollout, thresholds for edit distance and hallucination rate), demo canary UI, and on-prem installer ETA.
- Risks: on-prem timeline, p99 latency at peak sessions, and need for audit log retention policy alignment.
